title: Co-Immunoprecipitation assay for HA-tagged proteins from yeast
protocol: Collect approximately 5 × 108 cells expressing either untagged or HA-epitope tagged versions of protein from exponentially growing yeast cultures.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 4000xg to pellet them.
Wash the cell pellet once with water.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of lysis buffer.
Lysate the cells by vigorously shaking with glass beads for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Clarify the lysed sample at 13400xg for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Keep 10 μl from the supernatant as a control whole-cell extract.
Wash twice 50µL of Dynabeads with PBS containing Tween 0.02%.
Incubate dried beads with 10µL of HA-probe antibody in 190µL PBS-Tween 0,02% for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the unbound antibody twice with PBS-Tween 0,02%.
Incubate the remaining volume of whole cell extract with Dynabeads-antibody with orbital rotation for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Keep 10 μL from the supernatant as a control of unbound protein.
Wash the beads 5 times with PBS-Tween 0,02%.
Elute immunoprecipitated proteins by boiling the beads in 2x SDS-PAGE sample solvent for 5 minutes.
Analyze eluted proteins by SDS-polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis followed by Western blot analysis.
